about_the_game:
This game is currently in development. All media and descriptions shown are work in progress and subject to change.

Slashzone is a fast-paced multiplayer horror game for five players where teamwork matters, but in the end, only one walks away a winner.

Each match is made up of five intense rounds. In every round, a different player becomes the Slasher. Instead of choosing from a preset roster, you create your own unique Slasher from body parts, weapons, abilities, and passive powers. Your killer, your rules. The other four players take on the role of Volunteers, each selecting three items that could mean the difference between life and death.

Volunteers need to work together to rescue hostages, craft antidotes, and avoid the slasher. But here is the twist: they’re also competing for points, and only one of them can win. Help your teammates... or sabotage them when it suits you. Every choice is a gamble, and everyone is watching.

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content. Gameplay includes stylized depictions of death, such as character dismemberment, gibbing, and self-destruction.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2016
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, x86_64 CPU, ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU with Vulkan support
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: yes
  • Additional Notes: Stable internet connection
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2016
  • Processor: x86_64 CPU with SSE4.2 instructions, with 4 physical cores or more, ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU with Vulkan support
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: yes
  • Additional Notes: Stable internet connection
